titulo: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
resumo_original: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.

titulo: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
resumo_original: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.

titulo: US government grounds all flights across the United States ‘due to extraordinary circumstances’
resumo_original: A spokesperson for the FAA told TechCrunch that it issued the ground stop "following communication issues impacting multiple Air Route Traffic Control Centers," which manage the airspace across the United States.

titulo: This young startup wants to power floating data centers with the ocean’s heat, and investors are already on board
resumo_original: Drogue is harvesting heat from the ocean to power data centers on floating vessels. The first prototype should be bobbing around the ocean, crunching bits, in less than two years.

titulo: AI agent startup LangChain hits $3B valuation
resumo_original: LangChain now claims 7,000 customers of its model and platform agnostic agent management tool LangSmith.
